summary: The study investigates the structural properties of Al2O3 dielectrics grown on TiN metal substrates using atomic layer deposition (ALD) with tri-methyl-aluminum (TMA) and either O3 or H2O as oxidants. The effects of different oxidants and temperatures on film morphology, structure, and composition were analyzed using AFM, XRD, and XPS.
evidence: We investigated on the structural properties of Al2O3 dielectrics grown on TiN metal substrates using an atomic layer deposition technique with tri-methyl-aluminum and either O3 or H2O as the precursor and oxidant, respectively.
